items.title: Cognition, maker of AI coding agent Devin, in talks to raise at a $40B valuation
items.note: Up from $26B in May after hitting a $492M annualized revenue run rate, enterprise Devin usage up 50% month over month

items.title: Google's Gemini app surges to 1 billion monthly users
items.note: Google's fastest-growing product ever, reaching the mark within a month of hitting 950 million

items.title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer, an open-weight model built for AI agents on consumer hardware
items.note: 30B-parameter open version of Muse Spark under Apache 2.0, aimed at running personal agents locally

items.title: Home price cuts close in on last year's levels as markets battle for leverage
items.note: 41.44% of active listings took a price cut the week of Aug 7, nearly matching 2025 as the year-over-year gap narrows to 0.41 points

items.title: Team8 raises $365M for a new AI-native enterprise fund
items.note: $265M for Fund III plus $100M+ for follow-ons, brings AUM to nearly $2B across eight funds since 2014
